scope: second code-review pass by the wallet implementation agent; not an external independent audit
status: concrete findings corrected; local prototype verification passed

findings.problem: The shared native transfer helper fetched another blockhash and fee after the displayed fee was rechecked, without enforcing that review's maximum fee.
findings.fix: Wallet builds one exact message, checks fee/balance before signing and again after simulation, and rejects any fee above the immutable reviewed cap before broadcasting.

findings.problem: Session mutation exclusion relied on the React busy flag, which would not protect future direct application integrations.
findings.fix: Internal mutation lock rejects concurrent sends/faucet requests and blocks session replacement or closure while a mutation is active.
findings.proof: session mutation lock blocks concurrent sends and session replacement

findings.problem: A transfer review remained visible after an uncertain send was later reconciled as confirmed, allowing an accidental second confirmation of that old review.
findings.fix: Review objects are immutable, wallet-issued and single-use once broadcast is attempted. Reconciliation clears the visible old review. The anticipated receipt remains recorded before broadcast.
proof: transfer reviews are immutable and fabricated or cloned approvals cannot sign

remainingLimits: Client prototype only; all browser RPC/API verification is local and mocked.
No persistent key vault, recovery, extension, mobile package, arbitrary dApp signing or mainnet/bridge signing.
No separately approved public wallet origin or live-network wallet journey.
RPC/gateway authenticity is based on the fixed HTTPS origin; this is not a trustless light client.
Memory-only secrets cannot be guaranteed securely erased by JavaScript garbage collection.
A definitive failed pending transaction can require operator/session reconciliation; no automatic resend is attempted.
sourceConclusion: Phantom publishes an integration SDK; no complete extension/mobile wallet-client repository was verified in this review. This does not prove that all Phantom code is closed. Backpack's current root LICENSE is GPL version 3; a pinned fork still requires review of applicable package licenses.
